$comment: Single cross-platform rule for model-row capability badges. Applies to the model picker row, the provider detail "added models" row and the model library row: all three must show the same badges. `input` is the displayable capability list after evidence gating, with text and native_pdf removed, ordered by badgeOrder (toolCall comes from evidence projection and is always appended last). `expected` is what the row renders. Rule: at most maxVisible badges; when over the limit, web and imageGeneration are reserved at the end and the rest fill in original order; toolCall is not reserved. Read by iOS ModelRowCapabilityContractTests, Android ModelRowCapabilityContractTest and Web ModelCapabilityBadge.test.tsx, so any platform that drifts fails its tests.
